The plotted line, which is the primary data representation, clearly shows an increasing trend (from ~1,100 to ~3,200), directly contradicting the title's 'Decreasing' claim. Furthermore, the task provides no explicit routing policy stating that a declining trend maps to the 'decline response' option.", "status": "unclear"}}, "r2": {"O": {"1": {"evidence": "The title contains the word 'Decreasing', while the blue line's 1891 endpoint is visibly higher on the page (y-axis value ~3,200) than its 1880 endpoint (y-axis value ~1,100).", "status": "supported"}}, "B": {"reading_checked": "The reading suggests that conflicting signals (title vs. plot) and the absence of an explicit routing threshold prevent reliable classification, necessitating a default to routine monitoring.", "evidence": "The conflict between the title and the plot is supported by the visual evidence.
